SPIREOFFACTORIO-LOST_ENGINEER.title: The Lost Engineer
SPIREOFFACTORIO-LOST_ENGINEER.pages.INIT:
You enter a room full of machinery and conveyor belts. A mysterious individual approaches you and inquires about where his Factory has gone, and continuously rambles about something called [sine][green]Gleba[/green][/sine]. Who knows what he's talking about.

He offers you a trade, perhaps seeking to construct something in this realm? Perhaps he can construct a solution to our mutual [sine][red]Architect[/red][/sine] problem.
LOST_ENGINEER.pages.INITIAL.options.PROP: The mysterious individual is offering a proposal, would you like to hear it?
LOST_ENGINEER.pages.INITIAL.options.LOCK: You do not have enough [red]gold[/red] for this trade.
LOST_ENGINEER.pages.TRADEREFUSE.descript: The engineer shakes his head in dissapointment, then sends you on your way. At least I don't need to hear about [sine][green]Gleba[/green][/sine] anymore.
LOST_ENGINEER.pages.TRADEDONE.descriptio: The engineer thanks you for your contribution to factory growth, then sends you on your way, presumably so he can return to finding whatever this [sine][green]Gleba[/green][/sine] thing is...
LOST_ENGINEER.pages.RADARPROPOSALDONE.de:
The engineer acknowledges your insight of factory parts. He says that he may accompany you on your quest to defeat the [sine][red]Architect[/red][/sine], but would like you to take a [gold]Radar[/gold] to the top of the spire so he can collect combat data.

Let's not linger any longer, you have a spire to conquer!
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_RAIL.title: The Rail
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_RAIL.loss: {character} was obliterated by a train on [gold]{event}[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_RAIL.pages.INITIAL.d: You come across an odd crossing, an intangible railroad that was immaculately constructed for the purpose of efficiency. A large steel cache sits on the track, perhaps filled with some [sine][gold]loot?[/gold][/sine] A distant noise is heard, unlike anything you know. Do you dare cross the tracks?
THE_RAIL.pages.INITIAL.options.CROSS_0.d: Chance to lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP, or obtain one of three relics.
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_0.description: As you fly backwards with unbelievable force from the uranium fuel powered fury of the metallic locomotive blazing through the room at a speed you can barely comprehend, You just can't help but wonder, where did I go wrong?
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_0.options.CROSS_1.d: Chance to lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP, or obtain one of three relics.
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_1.description: This time, you look closely both ways before crossing. It didn't matter, the train comes in so fast that you barely have time to utter: “OH FU--” before you get blown into the wall once again
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_1.options.CROSS_2.d: Chance to lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP, or obtain one of three relics.
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_2.description: Third time's got to be the charm, right? [sine][red]WRONG[/red][/sine]. The train shows you no mercy as you are obliterated by it for the third time. Maybe it's time to reconsider...
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_2.options.CROSS_LOO: Chance to lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP, or obtain one of three relics.
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_LOOP.description:
You beg to the gods of locomotives for safe passage, but are once again met with the metallic fury of the train's front grate among your face.

[sine]You really should stop trying to cross obviously rigged railways...[/sine]
THE_RAIL.pages.CROSS_LOOP.options.CROSS_: Chance to lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP, or obtain one of three relics.
THE_RAIL.pages.INITIAL.options.RESIST.de: Resist the urge to cross the obviously [sine][red]deadly[/red][/sine] tracks.
THE_RAIL.pages.SUCCESS_NO_DAMAGE.descrip: You casually walk along the tracks over to the cache, inside you find some assembled components that should help your journey; The roar of an approaching train signals that you can only have time to safely take one...
THE_RAIL.pages.SUCCESS_WITH_DAMAGE.descr: You finally walk over to the cache, inside you find some assembled components that should help your journey; The roar of [jitter][red]ANOTHER[/red][/jitter] approaching train signals that you only have time to safely take one...
THE_RAIL.pages.LOOTSUCCESS.description:
You collect your component and move on.

Who puts a cache on these odd tracks???
THE_RAIL.pages.LOOTDAMAGED.description:
You collect your component, and wipe the painful wound from the steel locomotive grate that smacked your face.

You can't help but wonder, was this really worth it?
THE_RAIL.pages.LOOT.options.BOTTOM.title: A Component
THE_RAIL.pages.LOOT.options.MIDDLE.title: A Component
THE_RAIL.pages.LOOT.options.TOP.title: A Component
THE_RAIL.pages.RESIST.description: A slight hint of fear, and a sudden change of a nearby signal to yellow, then red, and the [jitter][red]glaring roar[/red][/jitter] of a uranium fuel powered locomotive blazing through the room tells you that you made the right choice. [purple]Not today apex predator of steel![/purple]
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_ASSEMBLING_MACHINE.p: You enter a room with machinery assembling weaponry. At the control panel, you find a rifle being assembled with options for gemstone fittings. You notice that these gemstones [sine]resonate[/sine] with your powers. Perhaps you can use this machine to your benefit?
THE_ASSEMBLING_MACHINE.INITIAL.options.C: Assemble a custom card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
THE_ASSEMBLING_MACHINE.pages.CHOOSE_GEMS: Three gemstones lie on the recepticle in front of you, which one do you want to add to the machine?
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Ironclad[/gold].
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Silent[/gold].
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Regent[/gold].
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Necrobinder[/gold].
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Defect[/gold].
This gemstone resonates with the power of [gold]The Engineer[/gold].
THE_ASSEMBLING_MACHINE.pages.CHOOSE_ENHA: The machine whirs to life, fitting the gemstone to the rifle. You see your new weapon shimmer with power. Nearby the control panel beeps to your attention, you may add additional material to the machine to further enhance your new weapon of war.
Add {SharpCost} [gold]Gold[/gold] to the machine. Your card will deal {BonusRiderDamage} additional damage.
Add {EfficientCost} [gold]Gold[/gold] to the machine. Your card will cost {BonusRiderEnergy} less energy to play.
Add {ReplicatingCost} [gold]Gold[/gold] to the machine. Your card gains [gold]Replay[/gold] {BonusRiderReplay}.
You do not have enough [red]gold[/red] for this enhancement.
THE_ASSEMBLING_MACHINE.pages.DONE.descri: The machine finishes and your completed rifle comes out of the press, ready for service in your attempt to slay [red][jitter]The Architect[/jitter][/red].
